description: Relative quantification from Ct values: ΔCt, ΔΔCt and fold change, with the standard error propagated from replicates. Picks the method from the amplicon efficiencies rather than leaving it to you — Livak's 2^-ΔΔCt when both are 100% efficient, the Pfaffl efficiency-corrected ratio when they are not, since running Livak over amplicons that do not qualify is the failure this tool exists to prevent. Reports what Livak would have said, so the size of that difference is visible.

controlReference.description: Ct values for the reference gene in the control sample.

controlTarget.description: Ct values for the gene of interest in the calibrator/control sample.

referenceEfficiency.description: Per-cycle amplification fold for the reference amplicon. 2.0 = 100%.

sampleReference.description: Ct values for the reference (housekeeping) gene in the same sample.

sampleTarget.description: Ct values for the gene of interest in the treated/test sample. Replicates as a list.

targetEfficiency.description: Per-cycle amplification fold for the target amplicon. 2.0 = 100%. From a standard curve, E = 10^(-1/slope).

name: qpcr_ddct
title: qPCR ΔΔCt fold change
